contracts.name: Electrographic seizure

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review

criteria: Either discharges averaging >2.5 Hz for >=10 s (>25 discharges/10 s), OR a pattern with definite evolution lasting >=10 s.
Sharply contoured discharges >200 ms may qualify through the high-rate pathway even when not technically epileptiform.
Evolution must satisfy the source RPP evolution criteria; amplitude change alone is insufficient.
exclusions: Do not infer neonatal seizure criteria from this contract
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Electrographic status epilepticus

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Enough recording for the continuous-duration branch or a 60-minute burden window

criteria: Qualifying ESz continues for >=10 minutes, OR total ESz duration is >=20% of any 60-minute interval.
Hourly burden uses the specified 60-minute denominator, not a cropped display's duration.
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Electroclinical seizure

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Clinical event/video evidence or documented EEG and clinical medication response

criteria: An EEG pattern with a definite time-locked clinical correlate, OR EEG AND clinical improvement after parenteral antiseizure medication.
A definite correlate must accompany the pattern and be absent when that pattern is absent; subtle signs can qualify.
Duration <10 s qualifies only with a definite clinical correlate. An ECSz need not meet ESz; report both when both qualify.
exclusions: Muscle artifact synthesized beside an event is not proof of a clinical correlate
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Electroclinical status epilepticus

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Clinical state, baseline in known epileptic encephalopathy, treatment/response timing where used

criteria: ECSz persists >=10 continuous minutes OR occupies >=20% of any 60-minute interval.
Exception: ongoing bilateral tonic-clonic motor seizure qualifies at >=5 continuous minutes.

Known epileptic encephalopathy additionally requires increased prominence/frequency of discharges from baseline with clinical deterioration, OR EEG and clinical improvement following parenteral antiseizure medication.
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Possible electroclinical status epilepticus
contracts.definition: Possible electroclinical status epilepticus classification requirements.

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Medication route/time and separate EEG versus clinical response

criteria: An IIC RPP persists >=10 continuous minutes OR >=20% of any 60-minute interval.
Parenteral antiseizure medication improves the EEG without clinical improvement.
All duration, IIC and response requirements are conjunctive.
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Nonconvulsive seizure/status qualifier

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Clinical motor observations; cannot be inferred from EEG alone

criteria: No prominent motor activity; applies to electrographic or electroclinical seizure/status.
Prefer nonconvulsive to subclinical: absence of prominent movement does not establish absence of clinical contribution.
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Stimulus-induced seizure/IIC/BIRDs qualifier

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Stimulus timestamps and responses; distinguish artifact

criteria: Alerting stimulus reproducibly induces or exacerbates the qualifying phenomenon; prepend SI to the qualifying term.
exclusions: Temporal proximity alone without reproducibility is insufficient
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Brief potentially ictal rhythmic discharges
contracts.definition: Brief potentially ictal rhythmic discharges classification requirements.

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Same-patient comparative EEG if similarity branch is used

criteria: Focal (L/BI/UI/Mf) or generalized rhythmic activity >4 Hz, at least six waves at a regular rate, duration >=0.5 s and <10 s.
Exclude known normal/benign patterns, activity forming part of burst-suppression/attenuation, and definite clinical correlates.
Definite: evolution OR morphology AND location resembling interictal discharges or seizures in the same patient.
Possible: sharply contoured without either definite criterion.
Paroxysmal fast activity of the stated duration can qualify, focal or generalized, subject to the defining exclusions.
exclusions: Do not equate neonatal BRDs with this definition
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Ictal-interictal continuum

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Full clinical context for interpretation; only waveform category is derived here

criteria: Always exclude ESz/ESE.
Pathway A: PD/SW averages >1 and <=2.5 Hz over 10 s.
Pathway B: PD/SW averages >=0.5 and <=1 Hz over 10 s AND has a plus modifier OR fluctuation (the plus/fluctuation disjunction applies within this pathway).
Pathway C: lateralized RDA averages >1 Hz for >=10 s AND has a plus modifier OR fluctuation (within this pathway); includes LRDA, BIRDA, UIRDA and MfRDA.
IIC describes an electrographic category, not a diagnosis or an automatic treatment order.
exclusions: GRDA does not qualify through pathway C
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Minimum clinical reporting context
contracts.definition: Minimum clinical reporting context classification requirements.

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Clinical-care reporting recommendation; not a synthetic waveform criterion

criteria: Review/report first 30–60 minutes promptly.
Written report at least once per 24 hours; significant intervening changes get separate epochs/reports.
Communication updates at least twice daily recommended except unusually stable circumstances.
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence

contracts.name: Pattern/seizure burden and index
contracts.definition: Pattern/seizure burden and index classification requirements.

applicability.setting: critical care; other settings with contextual review
required_context: Observation interval and interpretable duration must be retained; do not treat missing EEG as absence

criteria: Daily burden: total pattern or seizure duration per 24 hours; hourly and maximal hourly burdens also reportable.
Daily pattern index: daily burden multiplied by mean frequency; retain units (Hz-hours or Hz-minutes).
measurement_requirements: Independent waveform/timeline measurements; source-defined evolution adjudication where required
Retain observation duration, timestamps, uncertainty and concurrent clinical evidence
engineering_choices: Union overlapping intervals for occupied time; declare missing-data denominator policy in P3 rather than invent it as ACNS rule.
